description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates a paper-like folding effect on views such as ImageView and TextureView (camera feed). It manages user interactions, camera setup, animation, and visual effects related to folding.

classes.name: FoldingLayoutActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the folding view, user interactions, camera feed, and visual effects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, views, camera, and event listeners.

methods.name: setSepiaLayer
methods.description: Applies or removes a sepia filter layer on a specific view.

methods.name: animateFold
methods.description: Animates the folding view from current state to fully folded and back.
